name: datenum
expr: y3 = datenum(Y, M, D); y6 = datenum(Y, M, D, H, MI, S); ym = datenum([2026 5 9; 2026 2 30; 2026 13 9]); yrow = datenum([2026 5 9 12 30 45]);
comment: MATLAB datenum: serial date number from components. Covered: 3-arg (Y,M,D) with vector args (broadcast to column), 6-arg (Y,M,D,H,MI,S) with time fraction, single-arg Nx3 matrix, single-arg 1x6 row, month/day overflow (m=13 -> next year, d=30 of Feb -> March), year-zero edge. Deferred: string parsing (datenum('2026-05-09')) -- requires datestr/format-spec parser. Algorithm: Howard Hinnant days_from_civil + 719529 (MATLAB epoch).
